label: Town of Hardwick
header:
# Town of Hardwick municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 10; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Hardwick's five selectboard members as Shari Cornish, Larry Fliegelman, Ceilidh Galoway-Kane (Chair), Tim Ricciardello, and Derek Richardson. The directory's 'Galoway-Kane' is a misprint: the town report prints Ceilidh Galloway-Kane throughout, as does her town email address.

Town of Hardwick 2025 Town Report (hardwickvt.gov): the pre-meeting officers table seats Cornish to 2027 and Ricciardello to 2028 and shows the three seats that stood in March 2026 (two one-year seats and Galloway-Kane's three-year seat); the post-meeting directory board is the five minted here.

Charter of the Town of Hardwick, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 123 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 302(a)(1) makes the five selectboard members elective, on the section 303 rotation of three three-year and two one-year seats, by Australian ballot.
Charter of the Town of Hardwick, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 123 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 302(a)(2) makes the moderator elective.

Town of Hardwick 2025 Town Report (hardwickvt.gov): the officers table seats Orise Ainsworth as Moderator on a one-year term that expired at the March 2026 meeting, and the 2026 Warning stood the office. Structure only: the outcome is published in no official source read.

Charter of the Town of Hardwick, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 123 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 302(a)(5) establishes ONE combined elected office of Town Clerk and Treasurer on a three-year term (section 304(c)); it is modeled as the standard two posts with the same holder minted to both.
Town of Hardwick 2025 Town Report (hardwickvt.gov): the officers table seats Tonia Chase as Town Clerk & Town Treasurer on a three-year term expiring 2028.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Tonia Chase as Hardwick town clerk.
Charter of the Town of Hardwick, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 123 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 302(a)(5): the combined Clerk and Treasurer office (see the clerk post's note).
Town of Hardwick 2025 Town Report (hardwickvt.gov): Tonia Chase, three-year term expiring 2028.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Tonia Chase as Hardwick town treasurer.

Town of Hardwick 2025 Town Report (hardwickvt.gov): the officers table seats David Shepard as Town Agent on a one-year term that expired at the March 2026 meeting, and the town's March 3, 2026 Warning, Article 3, stands the Town Agent for one year. Structure only: the outcome is unpublished.

sources.note: Town of Hardwick 2025 Town Report (hardwickvt.gov): the town's 2026 Warning elects a Surveyor of Wood, Bark and Lumber for one year, and the officers table seats Levi Chase on a term that expired at that meeting. Structure only: the outcome is unpublished. The office is not a 17 V.S.A. section 2646 office; Hardwick's own warning carries it.
Charter of the Town of Hardwick, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 123 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 302(a)(13) makes the tree warden elective in Hardwick.
Town of Hardwick 2025 Town Report (hardwickvt.gov): the officers table seats Geoffrey Fehrs as Tree Warden on a term that expired at the March 2026 meeting. Structure only.
Charter of the Town of Hardwick, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 123 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 302(a)(15) makes one or more grand jurors elective.

Town of Hardwick 2025 Town Report (hardwickvt.gov): the officers table seats Raymond Bellavance as Town Grand Juror on a term that expired at the March 2026 meeting, and the warning stood one grand juror. Structure only.
Charter of the Town of Hardwick, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 123 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 302(a)(11) makes a First Constable elective.

Town of Hardwick 2025 Town Report (hardwickvt.gov): the officers table seats Lawrence Hamel as First Constable on a term that expired at the March 2026 meeting, which stood the office. Structure only.
Charter of the Town of Hardwick, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 123 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 302(a)(11) provides for a Second Constable if needed.

Town of Hardwick 2025 Town Report (hardwickvt.gov): the officers table seats Lindsay O'Steen as Second Constable on a term that expired at the March 2026 meeting, which stood the office. Structure only.

Town of Hardwick 2025 Town Report (hardwickvt.gov): the officers table seats seven elected trustees of the Jeudevine Memorial Library: Lauren Honican to 2027, Abrah Griggs to 2027, Vincent Razionale to 2028, Solomon Lew to 2028, and Mary Meyer to 2028 are minted; the 2026 Warning stood a three-year seat and a one-year remainder whose outcomes are unpublished, so two seats are unfilled.
Charter of the Town of Hardwick, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 123 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 302(a)(9) makes library trustees elective.

Town of Hardwick 2025 Town Report (hardwickvt.gov): the town's officials table lists five Hardwick Electric Commissioners -- the elected board of the town's municipal electric department: Renaud Demers to 2027, Michael Ambrosino to 2027, and Jake Lester to 2027 are minted; the two seats expiring in 2026 (Myles Kamisher-Koch's and Roger Prevot's) are unfilled, their outcomes unpublished.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists ten justices of the peace for Hardwick.

jp_election.name: Town of Hardwick Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the SOS listing names the ten Hardwick winners of the November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election. No cemetery-trustee post is created: the town's table seats the Selectboard itself as trustee of all seven town cemeteries, an ex officio trusteeship. No delinquent-tax-collector post: the Town Manager holds the function. The charter's fire-department officers (section 302(a)(10)) are not modeled pending a scope ruling.
